description: Main source file for a Bluetooth unicast audio client example using Zephyr RTOS, implementing Bluetooth LE audio streaming with LC3 codec support, including device discovery, connection management, stream configuration, and data transmission.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth LE passive scan for device discovery.

methods.name: get_and_incr_seq_num
methods.description: Retrieves and increments the sequence number for a given stream.

methods.name: fill_audio_buf_sin
methods.description: Fills a buffer with a sine wave for audio tone generation.

methods.name: lc3_audio_timer_timeout
methods.description: Handles periodic encoding and sending of LC3 audio frames.

methods.name: audio_timer_timeout
methods.description: Handles periodic sending of mock audio data when LC3 is not used.

methods.name: print_hex
methods.description: Prints buffer data in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: print_cb
methods.description: Callback to print parsed Bluetooth data.

methods.name: print_codec_cap
methods.description: Prints details of a codec capability.

methods.name: check_audio_support_and_connect
methods.description: Parses advertisement data to find and connect to an audio server.

methods.name: stream_configured
methods.description: Callback when a stream is configured.

methods.name: stream_qos_set
methods.description: Callback when stream QoS is set.

methods.name: stream_metadata_updated
methods.description: Callback when stream metadata is updated.

methods.name: stream_recv
methods.description: Callback for receiving incoming audio data.

methods.name: add_remote_source
methods.description: Adds a remote source endpoint to internal list.

methods.name: add_remote_sink
methods.description: Adds a remote sink endpoint to internal list.

methods.name: unicast_client_location_cb
methods.description: Handles location updates from the unicast client.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth and internal data structures.

methods.name: scan_and_connect
methods.description: Performs device scan and initiates connection.

methods.name: configure_stream
methods.description: Configures a specific stream with the server.

methods.name: create_group
methods.description: Creates a Bluetooth unicast group with configured streams.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main application loop managing Bluetooth connection, discovery, configuration, and streaming.
